# turingpi_node_power (Resource)

Manages the power state of a Turing Pi 2 node. This resource is idempotent - it will only change the power state if it differs from the desired state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "turingpi_node_power" "node1" {
  node     = 1
  power_on = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (Number) Node number (`1`-`4`).
- `power_on` (Boolean) Desired power state. `true` = powered on, `false` = powered off.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier.
